name: Kase Tsuyoshi
source:
"Interrogation of female students, including her, will be conducted within the school where the headmaster can see."

He graduated from the Yokohama Naval Academy in March together with Shindou Masanari. He has a friendly personality and is always considerate to those around him.

Sometimes he calls "Shindou-shoui" by just "Shindou" because of his school habit.

[Translated from [url=https://www.otomate.jp/chouchoujiken/chara/index10.php]official website[/url]]
